text:
zoe: Heads-up: main is red on integration-tests. looks like a KMS/ephemeral-creds authz failure in gha-runner. anyone available to rerun/bisect?

kai: I can look shortly. failing test is test/storage/kv_persistence — job fails during setup: decrypt: AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt

lukas: Same failure. runner logs show STS assume role returned limited scope token (no kms:Decrypt). suspect OIDC mapping change.

infra-bot: CI alert: workflow 'integration-tests' failed 7/8 jobs. Error snippet:
```
AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/gha-runner/runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh
```

zoe: @kai can you try a manual rerun with `gh run rerun <run-id>`? if it passes, we can bisect.

kai: Tried rerun — still fails. Here's runner env dump:
```
AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE=/tmp/oidc/token
AWS_ROLE_ARN=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-runner
AWS_REGION=us-west-2
```

lukas: Can you paste the run-id? I'll check OIDC audiences. Also check if repo OIDC trust was updated.

kai: run-id: 1234567890. digging... Found recent PR that tightened role condition `StringLike: { 'token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub': 'repo:redwood/*' }` — maybe our runners use `repo:org/name:ref:refs/heads/main` format.

zoe: If it's role condition mismatch, temporary fix: replace condition with `StringLikeIfExists`? But we should not change prod IAM in the middle. Let's bisect to the commit that changed IAM mapping.

lukas: I can run a quick bisect: start by re-running previous known-good commit 9f7a2c4 — @kai can you trigger a rerun for that sha? `gh api -X POST /repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runs/:run_id/rerun` with `ref=9f7a2c4`

kai: I don't have perms to re-run older commit. Who can? @nidhi?

nidhi: I can re-run. Kicked off rerun for sha 9f7a2c4 (run 1234570001). Will monitor.

infra-bot: Run 1234570001 completed: 8/8 passed.

zoe: Good — indicates regression introduced later. Let's bisect between 9f7a2c4 and HEAD. @nidhi can you start a binary search? if not, I'll open a quick PR to revert IAM change.

nidhi: I can run 2 test points: midpoint commit 2b4c1f. Triggered rerun 1234570022.

infra-bot: Run 1234570022 failed with AccessDenied kms:Decrypt.

lukas: That narrows: commit 2b4c1f -> HEAD includes the IAM mapping PR. I suggest revert on staging first. I'll open a draft revert PR and ping security.

zoe: Also add a temporary runner policy to allow kms:Decrypt for gha-runner role so hotfix doesn't touch trust relationship. @infra-bot give me the policy snippet.

infra-bot:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh",
      "Condition": {
        "DateLessThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

kai: If we apply that, ensure the condition scope is minimal: resource restricted and expires in 24h. I'll prepare terraform change and run apply, then rerun tests.

nidhi: I'm good with that plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
